speaker: Doctor
text: Does the pain worsen with specific neck movements, such as extension, or does it remain constant regardless of position? I need to determine if this is primarily radicular in origin or related to his diabetic neuropathy.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Burning pain in neck and arms, and weakness in both hands. I also have Paresthesias in hands, Absent reflexes, Decreased hand grip with fasciculations.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of fasciculations and weakness in both hands, combined with absent reflexes, raises concern for lower motor neuron involvement beyond simple cervical radiculopathy. REQUEST TEST: Cervical_Spine_MRI

text: RESULTS: Cervical Spine MRI shows a syrinx (cavity) within the spinal cord extending from the cervical to the upper thoracic region.

speaker: Doctor
text: The MRI findings of a cervical syrinx extending to the upper thoracic region, combined with your bilateral hand weakness and absent reflexes, strongly suggest Syringomyelia. DIAGNOSIS READY: Syringomyelia
